items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: I had a solo to play -- a sax solo, an aria from La Boehme

ctx.x: Some of them 60 years ago. And some things maybe are worth while. One thing in particular -- during our South American tour I remember our opening day at the Variety Theater in Buenos Aires I had a solo to play -- a sax solo, an aria from La Boehme --
Could I ask you what year this was?
